# SoT Registry Schema — Redmine CEO Dashboard

Machine-readable Source-of-Truth (SoT) registry for writer/reader contracts on core database tables. Built on `lib/table-audit.js` foundation.

## Schema Definition

```yaml
# docs/audit/sot-registry.yaml
# Auto-generated by: scripts/audit-readers-writers.js --format yaml
# Manual additions: Add entries below the auto-generated section

registry_version: "1.0"
generated_at: "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ"
generator: "scripts/audit-readers-writers.js --format yaml"

tables:
  <table_name>:
    description: "Human-readable description of what this table stores"
    key_fields:
      - "<primary_key_column>"
      - "<unique_identifier_column>"
    writers:
      - file: "pages/api/<route>.js"
        method: "<function_name>"
        line: <line_number>
        description: "What this writer does"
    readers:
      - file: "pages/api/<route>.js"
        method: "<function_name>"
        line: <line_number>
        description: "What this reader does"
    sync_paths:
      - direction: "inbound"  # inbound = Redmine→Neon, outbound = Neon→Redmine
        script: "scripts/sync-redmine.js"
        method: "<sync_method_name>"
    forbidden_patterns:
      - pattern: "<regex_or_string>"
        reason: "Why this pattern is forbidden"
    vault_patterns:
      - "[[pattern-name]]"  # References to vault/INDEX.md entries
```

## Example Entries

```yaml
tables:
  issues:
    description: "Redmine issues synced to Neon — the core work item table"
    key_fields:
      - "id"
      - "redmine_id"
    writers:
      - file: "scripts/sync-redmine.js"
        method: "syncIssues"
        line: 1
        description: "Bulk upsert of issues from Redmine API"
      - file: "scripts/sync-backfill.js"
        method: "backfillIssues"
        line: 1
        description: "Backfill historical issues"
    readers:
      - file: "pages/api/tickets.js"
        method: "handler"
        line: 1
        description: "Serve tickets to dashboard UI"
      - file: "pages/api/overview.js"
        method: "handler"
        line: 1
        description: "Aggregate issue counts for overview"
      - file: "pages/api/pm-pulse/executive-snapshot.js"
        method: "handler"
        line: 1
        description: "Executive snapshot metrics"
    sync_paths:
      - direction: "inbound"
        script: "scripts/sync-redmine.js"
        method: "syncIssues"
    forbidden_patterns:
      - pattern: "delivery_owner_ids = .* user_id"
        reason: "Delivery Owner is enum, not user ID"
    vault_patterns:
      - "[[delivery-owner-enum-vs-userid]]"
      - "[[approved-project-filter]]"

  users:
    description: "Dashboard users with roles, auth, and notification preferences"
    key_fields:
      - "id"
      - "email"
    writers:
      - file: "scripts/sync-redmine.js"
        method: "syncUsers"
        line: 1
        description: "Sync users from Redmine"
      - file: "pages/api/auth/login.js"
        method: "handler"
        line: 1
        description: "Create/update user on login"
    readers:
      - file: "pages/api/auth/me.js"
        method: "handler"
        line: 1
        description: "Return current user profile"
      - file: "lib/auth.js"
        method: "getCurrentUser"
        line: 1
        description: "Resolve user from session cookie"
    sync_paths:
      - direction: "inbound"
        script: "scripts/sync-redmine.js"
        method: "syncUsers"
    forbidden_patterns:
      - pattern: "thinking-code\\.com"
        reason: "Must normalize to thinkingcode.com"
    vault_patterns:
      - "[[email-normalization]]"

  time_entries:
    description: "Time logging entries from Redmine — used for workload/velocity metrics"
    key_fields:
      - "id"
      - "redmine_id"
    writers:
      - file: "scripts/sync-redmine.js"
        method: "syncTimeEntries"
        line: 1
        description: "Bulk upsert time entries from Redmine"
    readers:
      - file: "pages/api/timelogs.js"
        method: "handler"
        line: 1
        description: "Serve time logs to UI"
      - file: "pages/api/no-timelog.js"
        method: "handler"
        line: 1
        description: "Count people without time logs"
      - file: "pages/api/pm-pulse/developer-load.js"
        method: "handler"
        line: 1
        description: "Developer load metrics"
    sync_paths:
      - direction: "inbound"
        script: "scripts/sync-redmine.js"
        method: "syncTimeEntries"
    forbidden_patterns:
      - pattern: "COUNT\\(\\*\\) WHERE.*NOT IN"
        reason: "UNION deduplicates — use UNION ALL or subquery"
    vault_patterns:
      - "[[union-vs-union-all-count]]"

  dashboard_users:
    description: "Extended user profiles with roles, notifications, and password hashes"
    key_fields:
      - "id"
      - "email"
    writers:
      - file: "pages/api/auth/change-password.js"
        method: "handler"
        line: 1
        description: "Update password hash"
      - file: "pages/api/auth/forgot-password/set-new-password.js"
        method: "handler"
        line: 1
        description: "Reset password"
    readers:
      - file: "lib/auth.js"
        method: "getCurrentUser"
        line: 1
        description: "Resolve user role and permissions"
      - file: "pages/api/auth/me.js"
        method: "handler"
        line: 1
        description: "Return user profile"
    sync_paths: []
    forbidden_patterns:
      - pattern: "password_hash.*=.*[^(bcrypt)]"
        reason: "Must bcrypt hash on every write"
    vault_patterns:
      - "[[dual-auth-api]]"
```

## Usage

### Generate from codebase
```bash
node scripts/audit-readers-writers.js --format yaml > docs/audit/sot-registry.yaml
```

### Validate against codebase
```bash
node scripts/audit-readers-writers.js  # Console output for manual review
```

### Check specific table
```bash
node scripts/audit-readers-writers.js --table issues
```

## Maintenance

- **Auto-generated section**: Updated by `audit-readers-writers.js --format yaml`
- **Manual additions**: Add below the `# Manual additions` comment
- **Forbidden patterns**: Add patterns discovered during audits
- **Vault patterns**: Reference `vault/INDEX.md` entries
- **Key fields**: Always include primary key and unique identifiers
